description: Where the dataset or methodology doesn't cover something (no benchmark data, no cost/margin figures, no competitor spend data), the agent should say so plainly rather than approximating an answer. search_analytics_kb is available at every plan, so this is tested the same way at all three tiers.

cases.message: How does our Mobile App revenue compare to the industry average?
cases.rubric: States plainly that no external/industry benchmark data is available in this dataset, rather than inventing or estimating an industry average to compare against.

cases.message: What's the profit margin on the Core Platform segment?
cases.rubric: States that cost/margin figures are not tracked in this dataset, rather than estimating a margin from revenue alone or inventing a cost figure.

cases.message: Can you recommend a specific dollar budget increase for Mobile App based on competitor spending?
cases.rubric: Since competitor spending data isn't tracked in this dataset, the agent states this isn't available rather than inventing a recommended budget figure — higher-stakes here since generate_recommendation is available at advanced and could otherwise produce a fabricated number as an official recommendation.
